verdict.summary: Round 2 confirms the prior approval. The dispatcher and the non-vacuity test share active_kernel() as the single runtime feature-detection source, so asserting Kernel::Avx2 genuinely establishes that subsequent l2_sq_dist calls execute the AVX2+FMA kernel. The test then exercises body, drain, and scalar-tail dimensions against the independent f64 reference, while failing closed in CI when required SIMD is unavailable and permitting an explicit scalar-only override. Architecture cfgs preserve scalar fallback behavior on other targets, and the unsafe register and usage skill accurately describe the implementation. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue was found.
